root::BELLICUM_MILTENYI_Supply_Agreement.title: Miltenyi–Bellicum Master Supply Agreement
root::BELLICUM_MILTENYI_Supply_Agreement.summary: {{party-1|Miltenyi}} supplies cell-processing products to {{party-2|Bellicum}} for use in manufacturing cell-based therapies, under a non-exclusive, multi-year master contract with product-specific modules. {{party-2|Bellicum}} pays upfront and milestone fees, commits to minimum purchases, and receives a limited license; terms cover delivery, change control, and second sourcing.

parties.name: Miltenyi Biotec GmbH
parties.does: Supply cell-processing products, maintain quality, grant limited license, manage changes, and support second sourcing if needed.

parties.name: Bellicum Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
parties.does: Purchase products, pay fees and milestones, provide forecasts, meet minimum purchase, use products within license, and manage regulatory compliance.

root::SteelVaultCorp_20081224_10-K_EX-10.title: Affiliate Marketing Agreement between Equidata, Inc. and National Credit Report.com, LLC
root::SteelVaultCorp_20081224_10-K_EX-10.summary: This agreement allows {{party-2|National Credit Report.com, LLC}} to market and sell the personal credit and fraud detection services provided by {{party-1|Equidata, Inc.}}, under specified operational, compliance, and compensation terms, for an initial term of one year with automatic renewal unless terminated as outlined.

parties.name: Equidata, Inc.
parties.does: Provide credit-related services, invoice for services, approve marketing materials, and may audit affiliate's practices.

parties.name: National Credit Report.com, LLC
parties.does: Market and sell Equidata's services, collect payments from consumers, pay Equidata, comply with laws, and avoid soliciting Equidata's clients.

root::BELLICUMPHARMACEUTICALS,INC_05_07_.title: Miltenyi Biotec-Bellicum Supply Agreement
root::BELLICUMPHARMACEUTICALS,INC_05_07_.summary: Under this agreement, {{party-1|Miltenyi Biotec GmbH}} supplies specified products and technologies to {{party-2|Bellicum Pharmaceuticals, Inc.}} for use in Bellicum’s research, development, and manufacture of cell-based therapeutics, on agreed terms and pricing, for an initial term with possible renewal, covering worldwide territory.

parties.name: Miltenyi Biotec GmbH
parties.does: Supply products and technologies to Bellicum as specified.

parties.name: Bellicum Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
parties.does: Purchase and use Miltenyi products for development and manufacture of therapeutics.

root::Synthetic_HalversonCorvin_Reseller.title: Halverson Data Systems, Inc. / Corvin Outreach Group, LLC Reseller Agreement
root::Synthetic_HalversonCorvin_Reseller.summary: {{party-1|Halverson Data Systems}} appoints {{party-2|Corvin Outreach Group}} as a non-exclusive reseller of its cloud identity verification platform in Florida. {{party-2|Corvin Outreach Group}} pays subscription and setup fees per customer. The agreement lasts one year, renews automatically, and includes a personal guaranty by {{party-3|Daniel Okafor}}.

parties.name: Halverson Data Systems, Inc.
parties.does: Provide the platform, approve marketing, invoice fees, allow audits, and deliver customer services.

parties.name: Corvin Outreach Group, LLC
parties.does: Market and resell the platform in Florida, pay fees, use approved materials, comply with laws, and indemnify provider.

parties.name: Daniel Okafor
parties.does: Personally guarantee all payment obligations of Corvin Outreach Group under the agreement.

root::lease_contract_10.title: Premises Lease Contract for National Development Bank Tower
root::lease_contract_10.summary: Under this one-year lease, {{party-1|Zhonghai Trust Co.,Ltd}} leases premises and facilities at the 16th floor of National Development Bank Tower to {{party-2|Shaanxi Tianren Organic Food Co., Ltd.}} for work use, with specified rent, deposit, and terms for payment, maintenance, and possible purchase.

parties.name: Zhonghai Trust Co.,Ltd
parties.does: Lease premises, maintain property, provide documentation, coordinate delivery, issue invoices, notify of sale, repair damages.

parties.name: Shaanxi Tianren Organic Food Co., Ltd.
parties.does: Pay rent and deposit, use premises for work, bear utilities, maintain premises, avoid unauthorized sublease, return property at term end.

root::lease_contract_166.title: Lease Contract for Warehouse at No. 6 West Chengfou Road
root::lease_contract_166.summary: Under this two-year lease, {{party-1|the Lessor}} leases a 2520 m2 warehouse to {{party-2|the Lessee}} for residence, with annual rent, safety insurance, and utility fees payable as specified. Both parties share maintenance responsibilities. The contract covers subletting, transfer of ownership, and dispute resolution.

parties.name: CEEG (Nanjing) Special Transformers Co., Ltd.
parties.does: Lease warehouse, inform of ownership transfer, share maintenance, bear certain utility expenses.

parties.name: CEEG (Nanjing) PV-Tech Co., Ltd.
parties.does: Pay rent, insurance, utilities; manage premises; obtain consent for subletting; maintain property; restore damages.

root::lease_contract_201.title: Workshop Lease Contract between Bozhou Fengyi Chinese Medicine Development and Research Institute and Anhui Xuelingxian
root::lease_contract_201.summary: {{party-1|Lessor}} leases a 10,000 sqm workshop to {{party-2|Lessee}} at East Liuge Village for 15 years (Aug 1, 2008–July 31, 2023) at 1.2 million Yuan annual rent, with monthly payments and separate utility fees, under specified repair, use, and renewal terms.

parties.name: Bozhou Fengyi Chinese Medicine Development and Research Institute
parties.does: Lease workshop, maintain property, approve decorations, notify of sale, allow priority purchase, enforce contract terms.

parties.name: Anhui Xuelingxian Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
parties.does: Pay rent monthly, use premises lawfully, assist repairs, seek approval for decorations and exchanges, exercise renewal and purchase rights.

root::CONTRATO AREQUIPA SERVICE Alicia1.title: Contrato de Servicio de Nanas de Fin de Semana
root::CONTRATO AREQUIPA SERVICE Alicia1.summary: Por este contrato, {{party-1|Alicia Marybel Diaz Zea}} contrata a través de {{party-2|Arequipa Todo Servicios}} el servicio de nana de fin de semana, cama adentro o afuera, por un sueldo pactado, con garantía de reemplazo por 5 meses y pagos y condiciones específicas detalladas.

parties.name: Alicia Marybel Diaz Zea
parties.does: Paga honorarios y sueldo, solicita reemplazos, cumple condiciones de pago y aviso.

parties.name: Arequipa Todo Servicios
parties.does: Intermedia la contratación, gestiona reemplazos, valida documentos y administra pagos.
